# ArzanSite Backend API - Comprehensive Guide

1. [System Overview](#system-overview)

## System Overview

ArzanSite is a comprehensive website design and hosting platform built with NestJS backend and Appwrite as the database/storage solution. The system provides:

- **User Management**: Registration, authentication, profiles
- **Order Management**: Website design orders with wizard interface
- **Payment Processing**: ZarinPal integration and wallet system
- **Design Tools**: Dynamic design creation and management
- **File Management**: Document and design file storage
- **Analytics**: User behavior and business analytics
- **Admin Controls**: Administrative oversight and management

## Authentication & Security

### JWT Authentication
All protected endpoints require JWT authentication via:
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- `appwrite_jwt` cookie (set by backend after session creation)

### Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- **User**: Basic access to own resources
- **Admin**: Administrative access to all resources

### Security Features
- Helmet.js for security headers
- CORS protection with configurable origins
- Rate limiting (configurable per endpoint)
- Input validation and sanitization
- SQL injection protection via Appwrite

### 1. Authentication (`/auth`)

#### User Registration
```http
POST /api/auth/signup
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "SecurePassword123!",
  "metadata": {
    "name": "John Doe",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "company": "Example Corp",
    "phone": "+1234567890",
    "address": "123 Main St, City, Country"
  }
}
```

**Response:**
```json

  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "message": "User created successfully. Please check your email to verify your account.",
    "user": {
      "id": "64f8a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0",
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "emailVerification": false,
      "$createdAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
    },
    "verificationEmailSent": true,
    "requiresFrontendVerification": false
  },
  "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

## Data Models

### Core Entities

#### User
```typescript
interface User {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  emailVerification: boolean;
  $createdAt: string;
  $updatedAt: string;
}
```

#### Order
```typescript
interface Order {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'cancelled';
  price: number;
  payment_status: 'pending' | 'processing' | 'succeeded' | 'failed';
  wizard_data: WizardData;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}
```

#### Wallet
```typescript
interface Wallet {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  balance: number;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}
```

#### Transaction
```typescript
interface Transaction {
  id: string;
  wallet_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  type: 'deposit' | 'withdrawal' | 'payment' | 'refund' | 'credit' | 'debit';
  status: 'pending' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';
  amount: number;
  balance_before: number;
  balance_after: number;
  description?: string;
  reference_id?: string;
  reference_type?: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}
```

#### Invoice
```typescript
interface Invoice {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  orderId: string;
  amount: number;
  dueDate: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'paid' | 'overdue' | 'cancelled';
  description?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}
```

## System Architecture

### High-Level Architecture

```
┌─────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐
│   Frontend      │    │   NestJS API     │    │   Appwrite      │
│   (React/Vue)   │◄──►│   Backend        │◄──►│   Backend       │
│                 │    │                  │    │   Services      │
└─────────────────┘    └──────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
                       ┌──────────────────┐
                       │   External       │
                       │   Services       │
                       │   (ZarinPal,    │
                       │    SMTP, etc.)   │
                       └──────────────────┘
```

### Module Structure

```
src/
├── app.module.ts                 # Main application module
├── main.ts                       # Application bootstrap
├── appwrite/                     # Appwrite integration
│   ├── appwrite.service.ts      # Core Appwrite operations
│   ├── appwrite.config.ts       # Configuration
│   ├── database.controller.ts    # Database operations
│   ├── storage.controller.ts     # File storage
│   ├── functions.controller.ts   # Cloud functions
│   └── messaging.controller.ts   # Push notifications
├── auth/                         # Authentication system
│   ├── auth.controller.ts        # Auth endpoints
│   ├── auth.service.ts          # Auth business logic
│   └── dto/                     # Data transfer objects
├── orders/                       # Order management
│   ├── enhanced-orders.controller.ts
│   ├── enhanced-orders.service.ts
│   └── dto/
├── wallets/                      # Wallet system
│   ├── enhanced-wallets.controller.ts
│   ├── enhanced-wallets.service.ts
│   └── dto/
├── payments/                     # Payment processing
│   ├── enhanced-payments.controller.ts
│   ├── enhanced-payments.service.ts
│   ├── zarinpal.service.ts      # ZarinPal integration
│   └── dto/
├── invoices/                     # Invoice management
├── receipts/                     # Digital receipts
├── designs/                      # Design management
├── wizard/                       # Website wizard
├── uploads/                      # File uploads
├── analytics/                    # Analytics & reporting
├── notifications/                # Notification system
├── admin/                        # Admin controls
├── scheduled-tasks/              # Automated tasks
├── site-config/                  # Site configuration
├── domains/                      # Domain management
├── email/                        # Email services
└── common/                       # Shared components
    ├── guards/                   # Authentication guards
    ├── interceptors/             # Response transformers
    ├── filters/                  # Exception handling
    └── decorators/               # Custom decorators
```

### Data Flow

1. **Client Request** → **NestJS Controller**
2. **Controller** → **Service Layer** (Business Logic)
3. **Service** → **AppwriteService** (Data Operations)
4. **AppwriteService** → **Appwrite Backend** (Database/Storage)
5. **Response** → **Interceptor** (Transform/Format)
6. **Formatted Response** → **Client**

### Security Flow

1. **Request** → **JWT Guard** (Token Validation)
2. **JWT Guard** → **Appwrite/Backend JWT Verification**
3. **Validated Request** → **Roles Guard** (Permission Check)
4. **Authorized Request** → **Controller/Service**

## Integration with Appwrite

### Configuration
The system integrates with Appwrite through environment variables:


### Collections
- **orders**: Website design orders
- **wallets**: User wallet balances
- **transactions**: Financial transactions
- **profiles**: User profile information

# ArzanSite Backend API - New Endpoints Required

## Executive Summary

After thorough review of the admin components and their API usage, I've identified several missing endpoints that are required for full functionality. The current implementation uses existing endpoints correctly, but some features require new backend support.

## Current API Usage Analysis

### ✅ **Correctly Implemented Components**

1. **AdminDashboard.tsx** - Uses existing endpoints correctly
2. **AdminPaymentLogs.tsx** - Uses `getAdminPayments()` correctly
3. **AdminInvoiceManager.tsx** - Uses `getAdminInvoices()` correctly
4. **AdminReceiptManager.tsx** - Uses `getAdminReceipts()` correctly
5. **AdminDashboardStats.tsx** - Uses `getAdminDashboardStats()` correctly
6. **AdminWalletAdjustmentDialog.tsx** - Uses `adjustWalletBalance()` correctly

### ⚠️ **Components Requiring New Endpoints**

1. **AdminDashboard.tsx** - Missing user deletion endpoint
2. **AdminDashboard.tsx** - Missing domain management endpoints
3. **AdminDashboard.tsx** - Missing system health metrics endpoint
4. **AdminWalletManager.tsx** - Missing wallet adjustment history endpoint

## Required New Endpoints

### 1. User Management Endpoint

**Endpoint:** `DELETE /api/admin/users/{userId}`  
**Purpose:** Delete user accounts (admin only)  
**Required by:** AdminDashboard.tsx user deletion functionality

**Request:**
```http
DELETE /api/admin/users/{userId}
Authorization: Bearer <admin_jwt_token>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User deleted successfully",
  "data": {
    "deletedUserId": "user_123",
    "deletedAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

**Error Responses:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "User not found",
  "code": "USER_NOT_FOUND"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Cannot delete user with active orders",
  "code": "USER_HAS_ACTIVE_ORDERS"
}
```

## Data Models for New Endpoints

### Domain Extension Model
```typescript
interface DomainExtension {
  id: string;
  extension: string;
  price: number;
  available: boolean;
  description: string;
  isDefault: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}
```

### System Metrics Model
```typescript
interface SystemMetrics {
  system: {
    uptime: number;
    memoryUsage: number;
    cpuUsage: number;
    diskUsage: number;
    activeConnections: number;
  };
  database: {
    status: 'healthy' | 'warning' | 'critical';
    responseTime: number;
    activeQueries: number;
    connectionPool: {
      active: number;
      idle: number;
      max: number;
    };
```

## Implementation Guidelines

### Database Schema Updates

#### Domain Extensions Table
```sql
CREATE TABLE domain_extensions (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  extension VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  available BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  description TEXT,
  is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  category ENUM('country', 'generic', 'specialized') DEFAULT 'generic',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX idx_domain_extensions_extension ON domain_extensions(extension);
CREATE INDEX idx_domain_extensions_category ON domain_extensions(category);
```

#### Wallet Adjustments Table
```sql
CREATE TABLE wallet_adjustments (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  wallet_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  admin_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  type ENUM('credit', 'debit', 'correction') NOT NULL,
  amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  reason VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  balance_before DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  balance_after DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  metadata JSON,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  
  FOREIGN KEY (wallet_id) REFERENCES wallets(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (admin_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_wallet_adjustments_wallet_id ON wallet_adjustments(wallet_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_wallet_adjustments_admin_id ON wallet_adjustments(admin_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_wallet_adjustments_created_at ON wallet_adjustments(created_at);
```

#### System Metrics Table
```sql
CREATE TABLE system_metrics (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  metric_type ENUM('system', 'database', 'services', 'performance', 'security') NOT NULL,
  metric_data JSON NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX idx_system_metrics_type_created ON system_metrics(metric_type, created_at);
```

### Security Implementation

#### Rate Limiting
```typescript
// Rate limiting configuration
const rateLimitConfig = {
  'admin-system-metrics': { windowMs: 60000, max: 10 }, // 10 requests per minute
  'admin-domain-check': { windowMs: 60000, max: 50 },   // 50 requests per minute
  'admin-email-test': { windowMs: 300000, max: 5 }      // 5 requests per 5 minutes
};
```

#### Input Validation
```typescript
// Domain extension validation
const domainExtensionSchema = Joi.object({
  extension: Joi.string().pattern(/^\.[a-z]{2,}$/).required(),
  price: Joi.number().min(0).required(),
  description: Joi.string().max(500).required(),
  available: Joi.boolean().default(true),
  category: Joi.string().valid('country', 'generic', 'specialized').default('generic')
});

// User deletion validation
const deleteUserSchema = Joi.object({
  userId: Joi.string().uuid().required(),
  reason: Joi.string().max(500).optional(),
  forceDelete: Joi.boolean().default(false)
});
```

### Error Handling

#### Standardized Error Responses
```typescript
interface ApiError {
  success: false;
  error: string;
  code: string;
  details?: any;
  timestamp: string;
}

const errorCodes = {
  USER_NOT_FOUND: 'USER_NOT_FOUND',
  USER_HAS_ACTIVE_ORDERS: 'USER_HAS_ACTIVE_ORDERS',
  DOMAIN_EXTENSION_EXISTS: 'DOMAIN_EXTENSION_EXISTS',
  INVALID_DOMAIN_FORMAT: 'INVALID_DOMAIN_FORMAT',

};
```

```diff
+                           {adjustment.type === 'credit' ? '+' : adjustment.type === 'debit' ? '-' : '='}
+                           {WalletService.formatAmount(adjustment.amount)}
+                         </div>
+                         <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
+                           {WalletService.formatAmount(adjustment.balanceBefore)} → {WalletService.formatAmount(adjustment.balanceAfter)}
+                         </div>
+                       </div>
+                     </div>
+                   ))}
+                   
+                   <PaginationControls
+                     currentPage={adjustmentsCurrentPage}
+                     totalPages={adjustmentsTotalPages}
+                     onPageChange={setAdjustmentsCurrentPage}
+                     totalItems={adjustmentsTotalItems}
+                     itemsPerPage={10}
+                   />
+                 </div>
+               )}
+             </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
```

</details>
